questions.question: Mina, now a national reference in periodontology, is invited to an international congress. What message should she convey?
options: Periodontology is a model of prevention and preservation
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Periodontology is a model of prevention and preservation.' 🦅 Sami: 'I am proud of you.'

questions.explanation: 🦅 Sami explains: 'Promoting periodontal health and prevention is essential for the future.' 🐆 Mina: 'I will support this foundation.'
